role: Shared vocabulary of the assistant's provider layer: ProviderID identity/branding, ModelOption catalog entries, ChatTurn transcript model (with hand-written tolerant decoder), ToolSpec/ToolExchange tool-use types, AIStreamEvent stream events, API-key redaction, AIProviderError (fallback/guardrail policy + user text), ProviderAccountReply credit/purchase detection, ProviderHTTP (the cloud streamers' shared URL session, error-body/envelope/status mapping, mid-stream error chunks, cache-marker split and <live_state> envelope), the AIProvider protocol and AnyJSON encoder.
types: ProviderID: enum — the six AI backends (apple, anthropic, openai, gemini, grok, deepseek) with display/vendor/symbol/privacy URL
ModelOption: struct — one selectable model (apiID, context window, per-MTok prices, default flag)
AssistantSubsystem: enum — which AI surface produced a turn (coach, workoutVoiceCoach, voiceConversation, coachReport)
ChatTurn: struct — one persisted chat message (role, text, provider/model, subsystem, routed tier, localOnly)
ToolSpec: struct — tool name/description/JSON input schema sent to providers
ToolExchange: struct — a completed tool call + serialized result replayed in continuation requests
AIProviderError: enum (LocalizedError) — provider failure taxonomy with isFallbackable/isAppleGuardrail and localized messages
ProviderAccountReply: enum — string heuristics for credit-exhausted and purchase-prompt vendor replies
ProviderHTTP: enum — HTTP plumbing shared by AnthropicProvider, GeminiProvider and OpenAICompatibleStreamer
AIProvider: protocol — backend interface (id, models, key need, availability, tool cap, streaming send)
AIProvider: extension — default maxToolSchemaCount nil and 4-argument toolless send
AnyJSON: struct (Encodable) — re-encodes JSONSerialization output via Codable
state: mem:ProviderHTTP.streamSession (one URLSession: waitsForConnectivity, 30 s request / 180 s resource timeouts, 4 connections per host, no URL cache)
toplevel: Conformances: ProviderID String/Codable/CaseIterable/Identifiable; ModelOption Codable/Hashable/Identifiable/Sendable; AssistantSubsystem String/Codable; ChatTurn Codable (synthesized encode, custom decode)/Identifiable/Hashable/Sendable with stored default localOnly=false; ToolSpec Hashable/Codable/Sendable; AIStreamEvent.usage has default 0 for cache fields; AIProviderError LocalizedError.

units.does: Identifiable id: returns the raw value string of the ProviderID.

Returns the SF Symbol name shown on provider chips/rows (used by CoachHomeV2View, AIAssistantSettingsPage+Sections, ProviderConsentSheet, GrokQuirkPolicy).
Returns the vendor company name used in consent/privacy/error text (Apple, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, DeepSeek).
Returns the vendor privacy-policy URL shown in ProviderConsentSheet, AIAssistantSettingsPage and PrivacyPolicyView; all literals are valid so never nil in practice.
Identifiable id: "<providerID.rawValue>:<apiID>".
English identity label of the subsystem: Flo for coach/voiceConversation, Coach for workoutVoiceCoach, Flo Report for coachReport; ChatBubble shows it for Flo and a localized chip name otherwise.
SF Symbol glyph for the subsystem chip in ChatBubble.subsystemHeader.

Localized spoken self-announcement for a subsystem (from LanguageManager.appBundle). Only .workoutVoiceCoach (WorkoutVoiceCoach.swift:306) and .voiceConversation (VoiceConversationController+Speech.swift:92) are read in the app.
Memberwise initializer for ChatTurn with defaults: new UUID, now, nil provider/model/subsystem/tier, localOnly false.

Decodable init: decodes id/role/text/createdAt as required and providerID/modelID/subsystem/routedTierRaw/localOnly as optional, so transcripts written before localOnly existed still load; a missing required key throws.
units.entry: Decodable synthesis replacement — invoked by JSONDecoder when the chat transcript is loaded

branches.effect: defaults to false (turn treated as sendable); when present uses the stored Bool

units.does: Builds a top-level object schema: type fixed to "object", given properties and required list (both default empty).

Replaces anything matching 8 key/credential regexes (sk-ant-, sk-/sk-proj-, AIza, xai-, Bearer tokens, authorization:, x-api-key:, x-goog-api-key: headers) with "[redacted]" and returns the scrubbed string. Used on HTTP error bodies by Anthropic, Gemini and OpenAICompatibleStreamer.

branches.effect: each regex is applied in order to the progressively scrubbed text

units.does: True only for .guardrailViolation (Apple safety refusal); routing uses it to never re-send a refusal elsewhere.

Fallback policy: true for missingKey/authFailed/rateLimited/network/modelUnavailable/outOfCredit and also invalidResponse/unsupportedOS/unknown; false for guardrailViolation and cancelled. Read by AssistantViewModel+Routing.swift:632 to walk the fallback chain.

branches.cond: missingKey, authFailed, rateLimited, network, modelUnavailable, outOfCredit

branches.effect: true (treated as fallbackable so misconfiguration does not dead-end the chat)

units.does: Localized text for the Apple guardrail refusal ("Apple Intelligence declined to answer this...").

LocalizedError text for each case, localized from LanguageManager.appBundle; vendor-supplied text in invalidResponse/modelUnavailable/unknown passes through vendorText, which replaces purchase prompts.
units.entry: LocalizedError.errorDescription — read via localizedDescription by the chat error banner

branches.effect: "No <vendor> API key set. Add one in Settings → Flo."

units.does: Localized message that <vendor> declined because the API key has no credit left.
Returns shown() unless the vendor text carries a purchase prompt, in which case returns a neutral localized sentence about the key's account (App Store 3.1.1).

branches.effect: returns the closure's text unchanged; when true returns the neutral replacement

units.does: True when HTTP status is 402 or the lowercased body contains any credit marker (e.g. "credit balance is too low", "insufficient_quota", "spending limit").

branches.effect: true immediately; otherwise substring match on creditMarkers

units.does: True when the lowercased text contains any purchase marker (billing, add funds, purchase, payment, top up, recharge, ...).

The one URLSession every cloud streamer sends through: waitsForConnectivity (a cellular tower handoff waits instead of failing), 30 s request / 180 s resource timeouts, cellular/constrained/expensive access allowed, 4 connections per host, no URL cache.
units.entry: Initialised on first use by AnthropicProvider.stream, GeminiProvider.stream or OpenAICompatibleStreamer.connect.

units.does: Drains a failed response's byte stream into Data, stopping at 4096 bytes, for diagnostics.

Pulls error.message out of a vendor JSON error envelope ({"error":{"message":...}}, Anthropic's and Gemini's shape), redacted of API keys; nil when the body is not JSON, has no error object, or the message is empty.

branches.cond: no error object or empty message

units.does: Maps an HTTP failure status to the AIProviderError the chat shows: 401/403 authFailed, 429 rateLimited, 404 modelUnavailable(message), 5xx modelUnavailable(overloaded) — the caller's localized 'try again' sentence, evaluated only then — and anything else invalidResponse('HTTP <status>: <message>').

For a stream chunk that is an {"error":{...}} object (OpenAI-compatible and Gemini streams send one when a reply fails mid-stream after a 200), returns .invalidResponse with the redacted error message ('stream error' when it has none); nil for an ordinary chunk.

Splits the composed system prompt at AssistantSystemPrompt.Composed.cacheSplitMarker into the stable prefix (the whole prompt when there is no marker) and the variable suffix (later parts rejoined with the marker; empty when there is none).

branches.cond: prompt has more than one part
branches.effect: variable = the rest joined with the marker; else ''

Protocol requirement: stream a response for messages/model/context/system prompt/tools/tool rounds as AsyncThrowingStream<AIStreamEvent>.
Default protocol extension: no tool-schema cap (nil); GrokProvider overrides with 110.
Back-compat 4-argument send: forwards to the full send with empty tools and toolRounds. Used by the summarizer, auto-fact extractor and voice interjection.
Wraps an arbitrary JSONSerialization value for Codable encoding.
Encodes the wrapped value into a single-value container: CFBoolean NSNumber as Bool first, then String, Int, Double, Bool, arrays and dictionaries recursively, NSNull and anything else as null.
